selection: Nearest linear rainfall quantile among unused eligible seasons; ties prefer earlier historical start year.
calendar_policy: Require contiguous month/day-aligned historical dates with the same leap-day structure. Exclude incompatible seasons instead of fabricating days or dropping rain events.
initial_moisture_default: Median of training-only fallow readings on 16-22 February 2023.
simulation_starts: Day after decision_date; initial moisture represents end of decision_date.
simulation_ends: End of next_crop_planting_date; no following-crop growth simulated.
pre_cover_treatment: Both choices use fallow until the cover is planted.
model_policy: Use selected regression if available, otherwise saved best experimental regression. Preserve adoption status and baseline metrics; do not retrain or promote it.
